verdict.rationale: Airwallex explicitly offers Banking-as-a-Service with programmatic creation of connected accounts with local bank details in 60+ markets, multi-currency wallets, and issuing capabilities that developers can embed for their own customers without needing their own banking license — Airwallex holds the regulatory licenses underneath. This directly matches the embedded banking story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on case studies confirming real-world embedded deployments, and explicit clarification of licensing/liability allocation between Airwallex and the developer.
